pages.title: A World on the Wall
pages.text: Extra frames and shelves support a home gallery of traveled routes.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Explore with the map first. A framed map can show terrain in 3D; sneak-use opens its slice, height and mode options. Display quality is a separate client setting.
